Revenue grew every quarter in all four regions, and the regions stayed in the same order all year. **East** was highest each quarter, ending Q4 at $1,532K, followed by North, West and South. Total FY25 revenue was **$19.9M**, up from $4.63M in Q1 to $5.36M in Q4.

These figures are unaudited management accounts and may change after the year-end close. I left the notes column out of the chart.
